title: Nova agent session stalled ~3h11m on a Sonnet rolling-cap modal
cause_status: VERIFIED (was 'unverified' at first report; evidence-backed after diagnosis)
cause: Rolling/session Sonnet rate-limit. The TUI emitted 'You have hit your Sonnet limit, resets Jun 23 at 4am' and dropped into a blocking /rate-limit-options modal awaiting a keystroke. The session stayed alive but produced ~0 work until the 21:58Z heartbeat cron injected text that dismissed the modal. Rolling (5h-class) limit, not the hard weekly cap (it self-recovered before Jun 23).
classification: CAPPED (rolling, auto-cleared); symptom resembled SESSION_STALLED (frozen modal)
impact: missed the 18:49Z H10 lift evaluation (executed late ~22:00Z on recovery)
production review gate unavailable during the window (available again after recovery; review later completed PASS 5/5)
recovery_mechanism: heartbeat cron injected text dismissed the modal at 21:58:22Z
recurrence_risk: Nova weekly budget ~80%+; may re-hit the rolling cap under heavy load before the Jun 23 04:00 ET reset
remediation: Daemon-side fix filed (task): detect the /rate-limit-options modal and auto-select 'Stop and wait' or send Esc instead of waiting for the next cron. Prevents multi-hour dark periods for any Sonnet agent.
